__comment_operating_point__: U_pp = 2 and mu = 3 are MEASURED choices, not defaults -- ROADMAP task 4, gate 1, 2026-07-28.
At the repo test's U_pp = 0 the |H_int| > 1e-3 filter in general_interaction.hpp leaves the p
orbitals with no CT-AUX vertices, and the consequence is far stronger than 'less noise on p':
the p-block G comes out DETERMINISTIC (across-rank sigma ~ 1e-17 against |G| ~ 1.6) and the d-p
block is identically zero in the measured G. Every class except d-d then carries a raw-variance
share of ~1e-30, so R collapses to the single-band answer (measured 1.03-1.12 against square's
1.04) and the equivalent-orbital block that is the entire point of this model has no signal.
U_pp > 0 is therefore REQUIRED, not a variant. Symmetry is untouched by the choice: the derive
path gates on H0 alone, so P, n_ops and the orbit table are bit-identical at any U_pp.
mu = 3 places the Fermi level at the p site energy (ep_p = 3), which is what populates the p
orbitals. Measured at (U_pp=2, mu=3): occupancy 2.88 of 6 (48% of a filled cell) and all four
entry classes carry real variance -- equivalent-orbital share 0.708 vs 0.000 at U_pp = 0.
U_pp = 8 diverges outright (band occupancy 28.7, R = nan) and must not be used.
DCA's JSON reader ignores unknown keys, so this block is inert.
